title: Assistant Director of HR & Finance
bio: As part of her role, Bridget handles the financial and logistical needs of the Harvard College Office of Culture and Community, part of the Dean of Students Office. She also serves on the Faculty of Arts and Sciences Initiatives Engagement Council. Bridget has been at Harvard University, specifically Harvard College, since the Fall of 2006. She is skilled at Microsoft programs such as Excel, and at navigating Harvard’s Financial Systems. Bridget graduated with her B.A. from Harvard in 2024 from the Harvard Extension School. She loves music, touristing Boston for fun, and reading anything she can get her hands on. Bridget is also a good person to ask general questions about Boston and Harvard, as she is a lifelong Bostonian and has been at Harvard long enough to know many random yet useful facts.
